_comment: Manifest of hospitals in the pipeline. Status flow: discovered -> mapped -> parsed -> qa_pending -> seeded (or flagged). See docs/adding-a-hospital.md.

hospitals.name: Dell Seton Medical Center at UT Austin
Baylor Scott & White Medical Center Austin
hospitals.notes: Mislabels ~400k CPT-code rows as HCPCS. Handled by the default 5-digit-numeric promotion rule, not a per-hospital override -- column_map_file exists mainly as a record of the issue.

hospitals.name: St. David's Medical Center Austin
hospitals.notes: HCA-format CMS v3.0.0 JSON, nested structure -- parsed by parse-json.js, not parse-csv.js.

hospitals.name: The Methodist Hospital
hospitals.notes: CMS v3.0.0 JSON, same nested standard_charge_information/code_information/standard_charges/payers_information shape as st-davids-austin -- parsed by parse-json.js. Verified live 2026-10-11: HTTP 200, ~68.7MB, last-modified 2026-03-25. Flagship Texas Medical Center campus (CMS name 'The Methodist Hospital'); Houston Methodist also publishes separate files for Baytown, Clear Lake, Cypress, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, West Houston, Willowbrook, and Continuing Care -- not added here, each would need its own manifest entry. EIN taken from filename prefix, not an explicit field in this file's header (unlike the CSV hospitals). First QA pass failed (zero CPT codes -- found parse-json.js was missing the HCPCS->CPT promotion rule parse-csv.js already had; 138,437 codes were mislabeled). Fixed in parse-json.js, re-verified: 99.4% CPT overlap with other hospitals. See data/qa-reports/houston-methodist.md.

hospitals.name: The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center
hospitals.notes: CMS v3.0.0 WIDE-format CSV (1,421 columns, 47 payers), not tall like the Ascension files -- required a new scripts/parse-csv-wide.js, not a column-map override. Verified live 2026-10-11: HTTP 200, text/csv, ~120.6MB, last-modified 2026-10-07. QA passed (data/qa-reports/md-anderson-houston.md): 1,028,611 rows seeded, 96% CPT-code overlap with other hospitals, clean payer names, no negative rates. MD Anderson also separately publishes a ProfessionalCharge.csv (physician/professional charges, not facility standard charges) at the same path -- not added here; this pipeline tracks hospital facility files only, consistent with the other 4 hospitals.

hospitals.name: UT Southwestern Medical Center - William P. Clements Jr. University Hospital
hospitals.notes: Discovered via cms-hpt.txt at https://utswmed.org/cms-hpt.txt, which points to source-page https://search.hospitalpriceindex.com/hpi2/machineReadable/UniversityofTexasSouthwesternMedicalCenter/10906 (vendor: Hospital Price Index / sthpiprd.blob.core.windows.net Azure blob storage) and the direct mrf-url used here. CMS filename gives EIN 75-3175630 and names the facility 'The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center at Dallas'; the vendor portal's own location-name is 'William P Clements Jr University Hospital'. Per the hpi2 landing page, this single file's pricing data covers William P. Clements Jr. University Hospital, Zale Lipshy Pavilion, hospital-based clinics, and ambulatory-based clinics across the health system -- so Zale Lipshy likely does not need a separate manifest entry, but this should be confirmed once the file is parsed (check for a hospital/location column). Verified live 2026-10-11: HTTP 200, Content-Type application/octet-stream (despite .csv extension), Content-Length 1,483,795,643 bytes (~1.48GB), Last-Modified 2026-03-10. Pre-flight check (2026-10-11): tall layout confirmed, 30 columns, clean code-type distribution (97.5%+ match on all 8 code types across 9,051 sampled rows) -- no mislabeling risk, schema-mapper step skipped. One unrecognized column (additional_payer_notes), expected to be dropped by parse-csv.js's default handling. UT System also operates other facilities (e.g. UT Southwestern-affiliated clinics); only the main hospital MRF was added here. Seeded 2026-10-12: 2,946,836 rows. Confirmed via better-sqlite3 locally after the Sprite seed-db run (quadratic COUNT(*) bug) and this Sprite instance (degraded overnight I/O) both had to be abandoned -- completed instead via local fetch+parse+seed, total 7m22s for all 7 hospitals.

hospitals.name: Memorial Hermann-Texas Medical Center
hospitals.notes: Discovered via cms-hpt.txt at https://memorialhermann.org/cms-hpt.txt, which lists 19 separate Memorial Hermann hospital/imaging-center locations, each with its own distinct MRF file -- confirmed unambiguous match for 'Memorial Hermann-Texas Medical Center' (flagship TMC campus). .ashx URL and the equivalent .csv URL (same path, .csv extension, referenced on the landing page https://memorialhermann.org/patients-visitors/patient-services/financial-care/financial-resources/cms-price-transparency-information) both resolve to the identical file (same Content-Length, same Content-Disposition filename). Verified live 2026-10-12: HTTP 200, Content-Type text/csv, Content-Length 36,141,332 bytes (~34.5MB); no Last-Modified header returned. Sibling facilities published as SEPARATE files, not included here: Children's Memorial Hermann Hospital (same TMC campus, but a distinct licensed facility with its own CMS file -- 741152597_childrens-memorial-hermann-hospital_standardcharges.ashx) and Memorial Hermann Imaging Center (Texas Medical Center) (741152597_mhhs-opid-hermann_standardcharges.ashx). System also separately publishes files for Cypress, Greater Heights, Katy, Memorial City, Northeast, Pearland, Southeast, Southwest, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, TIRR Memorial Hermann, Memorial Hermann Rehabilitation Hospital-Katy (different EIN 263896170), and imaging centers at Bellaire, Cypress, and Upper Kirby -- none added here. Most locations share system EIN 741152597. Pre-flight (2026-10-12) flagged the same CPT-mislabeled-as-HCPCS pattern seen on bsw-austin/houston-methodist (tall layout, 27 columns); handled by the existing DEFAULT_PROMOTIONS rule in parse-csv.js, no column-map override needed -- schema-mapper step skipped. Parsed cleanly: 131,481/131,481 rows kept. QA passed (data/qa-reports/memorial-hermann-tmc.md): CPT promotion confirmed working (0% mislabeled), 99.0% CPT overlap with other seeded hospitals, price sanity clean, null rate 26.6%. Two non-blocking flags: ~270 rows (166 codes) tagged CPT that look like HCPCS Level II (opposite-direction mislabeling, worth a follow-up promotion rule if other MH facility files share it); payer-name casing duplicates (Bcbs/BCBS etc., pre-existing issue class). Seeded 2026-10-12 via per-hospital upsert: 115,797 rows (15,684 filtered as non-CPT/HCPCS/DRG). First seed-db run was killed mid-way by this Sprite's recurring I/O degradation (same issue noted on utsw-dallas); re-run succeeded after upsertHospital's delete-then-reinsert self-healed the partial state. Note: this Sprite's local data/prices.db is still missing dell-seton-austin, st-davids-austin, houston-methodist, md-anderson-houston, and utsw-dallas despite their 'seeded' status (pre-existing gap, not caused by or fixed as part of this hospital's onboarding) -- a full rebuild or sync from wherever those were actually seeded is needed before deploy.

hospitals.name: Texas Children's Hospital
hospitals.notes: Found via https://www.texaschildrens.org/patients-families/insurance-and-billing/cost-estimate, which lists 4 separate campus files sharing the same system EIN (741100555): main Houston/Texas Medical Center campus (this entry), The Woodlands, West Campus, and North Austin Campus -- none of the others added here. Page also links a Transparency-in-Coverage (payer negotiated rates, not hospital standard charges) portal at https://www.ticmrf.com/74-1100555, which is out of scope for this pipeline. Verified live 2026-10-13: HTTP 200, Content-Type application/zip, Content-Length 40,436,431 bytes (~38.6MB), Last-Modified 2026-03-18. Did not download the full file initially -- fetched only the last 100KB via Range request and parsed the zip's central directory locally to confirm contents (single entry, csv, ~342MB uncompressed). Pre-flight flagged a mislabeling risk opposite the BSW/Houston Methodist pattern: 20% of code|3 rows labeled CPT are actually letter+4-digit HCPCS Level II codes (C1713, P9011, etc.). column-maps/texas-childrens-hospital.json adds a promotion rule (CPT->HCPCS, pattern ^[A-Z]\d{4}$) alongside the default rules. Parsed cleanly: 1,432,826/1,432,826 rows kept (100% survival). QA passed all six checks (data/qa-reports/texas-childrens-hospital.md) -- code-type fix verified correct in both directions, zero negative prices, 0.00% null rows, 99.96%/99.0% CPT/HCPCS cross-hospital overlap, clean payer names. One non-blocking cosmetic flag: 3 HCPCS codes (j9075, j3490, j2997) have lowercase duplicates (~0.02% of rows), a raw-file casing quirk not a mislabeling. Worker-1's interactive session errored out before it could git-push the hospital/texas-childrens-hospital branch (no git credentials on the non-interactive sprite-exec session) -- recovered via sprite file pull of the QA report, column-map, and NDJSON directly instead of the git-branch handoff.
